summary: feat(settings): apply Nova Settings nav, dividers and status colors
description:
Because:
- Updated Figma and design answers cover the nav, dividers, AlertBar and status colors.

This commit:
- Styles Nav items as Acorn page-nav pills with a filled selected state.
- Uses border-deemphasized for Settings dividers and the device box.
- Restyles AlertBar as a tinted pill with a circular close button.
- Maps status fills to Acorn icon colors and drops gradients under nova:.
- Adds nova:-only nav, icon and border-deemphasized utilities.
